rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Hormones = chemical messengers made in ductless (endocrine) glands, carried by blood to target organs, active in tiny amounts — the four defining features.  ·  Trick 2: Types: steroids (cortisol, sex hormones), proteins/peptides (insulin, growth hormone), amines (adrenaline, thyroxine) — one example each.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Trick 3: Function pairs: insulin lowers blood glucose (diabetes = deficiency); thyroxine controls BMR (goitre = iodine deficiency); adrenaline fight-or-flight; growth hormone — deficiency dwarfism, excess gigantism.  ·  Trick 4: Adrenaline (epinephrine) raises blood pressure and heart rate in stress — the classic 'emergency hormone' line.  ·  define + example each sub-idea: hormones, definition, types, functions.
